resources.title: Azure ML SDK v2 Quick Reference
resources.description: A compiled, copy-paste reference of every azure-ai-ml (SDK v2) pattern this course teaches — connecting to a workspace, creating compute, registering data assets, logging with MLflow, registering a model, and deploying real-time, batch and monitoring resources — pulled from the lessons and organized by task instead of by lesson order, with a clean-up checklist at the end.

resources.title: Churn Capstone Starter Dataset
resources.description: A ready-to-use 500-row CSV of synthetic Northwind Streams customers (tenure_months, monthly_spend, support_tickets, contract, churned) built with the same schema and churn-by-segment pattern as the capstone's own make_data() function, so you can start training immediately instead of regenerating data from scratch.

resources.title: Azure ML Model Card Template
resources.description: A fill-in-the-blanks model card wired to the fields your MLflow registry already has (model name/version, run metrics, tags), plus a complete worked fill-in using the course's own churn model — including its real segment-performance table and the precision/recall trade-off from the per-segment threshold experiment.

resources.title: Drift & Fairness Check Toolkit
resources.description: Ready-to-run Python for the two checks taught in the Deployment & Monitoring chapter: a PSI/Jensen-Shannon/KS drift check against reference data, and a Fairlearn-style segment breakdown (by pandas groupby or the fairlearn library) that catches a model working unevenly across groups even when its overall AUC looks fine.
